limitations: One-hour synthetic captured linearizations; this is not the24/48/72-hour benchmark or flight fit equivalence.

The300-second pulse shifts had no interior original-parameter movement and are reported only as numerical equivalence without cut coverage. The1800-second shifts supply genuine interior movement for both periods and methods.
The gradient in this diagnostic has unit denominator, not the nonlinear objective normalization.
Only undamped linearization covariance is checked; no accepted-fit covariance, speedup or release approval follows.
Raw row energy/equality checks use independent binary64 products and math.fsum; original dense MAP/covariance use independent SciPy triangular and QR calculations.

coverage.definition: An original retained parameter changes elimination owner to a strictly interior native-grid epoch; unchanged ownership cannot certify cut coverage.
